title: Rafael and the Harvest
author: Felix Okonkwo
blurb: Yara Voss, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
